decisions.reason: As a core multi-model garage-door operator line closely tied to the firm's main offering, it remains a valuable complement whose upside still outweighs the modest cost of keeping it.

As a niche solid-wood variant with weaker commitment signals and likely higher complexity, its prospects have had enough time to become clearer and resources are better redirected to broader lines and new development.
Because this lightly presented remote-control operator largely overlaps with the broader operator range, the separate option value is now low and management would likely discontinue or absorb it.
This glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's core industrial door systems and its earlier dedicated presentation indicates enough strategic value to justify keeping it on the market.
